summary: Nez Perce National Forest lookout 16 miles SW of Elk City, Idaho: 50-foot L-4 pole tower built about 1933, knocked over 1963; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: No source we read describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: Knocked over; the firelookout.com header gives 1965 instead, see resolved_conflicts

sources.title: Forest Fire Lookout Association Idaho lookout list

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The firelookout.com header gives R.I.P. 1933-1965, but the same page says the tower was knocked over in 1963. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page and the Forest Service list both give 1963. The story uses 1963.

notes_for_editor: Dates for the build (about 1933) and the 1963 loss agree across three sources, apart from the 1965 in the firelookout.com header. The Idaho page's Selway label is a regional grouping; the agency (Nez Perce National Forest) comes from firelookout.com and the Forest Service list. No present-day site description was found in these sources. The record had no events, so the 1933 and 1963 events are new.
